T: Made men always go back for seconds.
D: A Brooklyn kid works his way up the mob ladder, from the cab stand to the biggest airport cargo heist in the country.
P: Plate up the mains when Paulie starts slicing garlic in the prison kitchen.
S: Paulie's razor blade garlic, sliced so fine it melts in the oil
Slice garlic as thin as you can on a mandoline, sweat in olive oil over low heat until soft and barely golden. Spoon over grilled ciabatta rubbed with tomato, salt and torn basil.
poached prawns on iceberg with brandy Marie Rose and paprika, served in coupes at the Copa

Poach peeled prawns 2 minutes in salted water with lemon and bay, ice bath. Marie Rose with whole-egg mayo, tomato sauce, Worcestershire, hot sauce and brandy. Iceberg, prawns, sauce, paprika, lemon wedge, in coupes.
Crew's back booth salami and provolone
thick-cut Genoa and sharp cheese, pepperoncini and torn bread, as served at the Bamboo Lounge
Thick-cut Genoa salami and sharp provolone, pepperoncini, marinated mushrooms and a loaf of seeded Italian bread torn by hand.
M: veal, beef and pork, and fewer onions than Vinnie uses

Mix equal veal, beef and pork mince with milk-soaked bread, egg, pecorino, parsley and garlic. Brown, then into a tomato sauce built on razor-thin garlic and a little onion. Simmer 90 minutes, serve with spaghetti.
seared rump simmered in garlic, oregano and chilli tomato, crusty bread for the 3am visit

Season thin porterhouse or rump, sear hard and rest. In the same pan, garlic, oregano, chilli and a tin of crushed tomatoes, simmer 15 minutes. Return the steak to warm through, crusty bread for the sauce.
W: a hot Brooklyn summer on the corner
Simmer 200g sugar with 500ml water and lemon zest, cool, add 250ml lemon juice. Freeze in a tray, scraping with a fork every 30 minutes for 3 hours until fluffy. Serve in paper cups.
K: whisky, honey ginger syrup, lemon and soda over big ice, toasting the Lufthansa score

Blended Scotch over big ice with honey-ginger syrup and fresh lemon, topped with cold soda and a curl of lemon peel. Make the syrup: simmer 60g honey, 60ml water and 30g sliced ginger for 5 minutes, then cool and strain. Fill 4 highball glasses with large ice cubes. Add 45ml Scotch, 15ml ginger syrup and 10ml lemon juice to each and stir for 10 seconds. Top each with 120ml chilled soda water, stir once and finish with a curl of lemon peel.

dishes.make_ahead: Sauce up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Soak the bread in the milk, then mix with the minces, egg, pecorino, parsley and 1 crushed garlic clove.
Roll into 16 balls and brown in olive oil.
In the same pot gently cook the remaining garlic sliced razor thin and the onion, add the tomatoes and the meatballs, and simmer.
Cook the spaghetti and serve with the sauce and meatballs.

veg.n: Prison gravy with mushroom and ricotta meatballs
veg.make_ahead: Sauce up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled. Meatballs can be rolled 1 day ahead

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the olive oil until all their liquid has gone and they are browned, then cool.
Soak the bread in the milk, then mix with the mushrooms, ricotta, egg, cheese, breadcrumbs, parsley, 1 crushed garlic clove and salt and pepper. Chill for 15 minutes.
Roll into 16 balls and brown gently in the rest of the olive oil, turning carefully. Lift out.
In the same pot gently cook the remaining garlic sliced razor thin and the onion, add the tomatoes and simmer for 45 minutes, then add the meatballs for the last 15 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti and serve with the sauce and meatballs.

dishes.make_ahead: Season the steaks and leave them out of the fridge for 30 minutes before cooking; best cooked and rested just before serving

steps.text: Take the rump steaks out of the fridge 30 minutes early and season well with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a heavy pan until smoking.
Cook the steaks two at a time, 2 to 3 minutes each side for rare or 4 minutes for medium.
In the last minute add the butter and smashed garlic and spoon them over the steaks.
Rest the steaks for 5 minutes before serving.

veg.make_ahead: Wipe and trim the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead and keep them in the fridge; season and cook on the night

steps.text: Wipe the portobello mushrooms, trim the stems and season well with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a heavy pan until smoking.
Cook the mushrooms four at a time, gill side up first, pressing down with a spatula, about 4 minutes each side until browned and tender.
In the last minute add the butter and smashed garlic and spoon them over the mushrooms.
Rest for 2 minutes before serving.

dishes.make_ahead: Open the bottles an hour before dinner

steps.text: Open the bottles of Chianti and Montepulciano red wine an hour before dinner and leave them to breathe.
Pour the wine into short tumblers at the table.

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes for a strong tea, then remove and cool.
Mix the grape juice, tea and balsamic vinegar in a carafe an hour before dinner and chill.
Pour into short tumblers at the table.

edition.tagline: A life in the crew, told one plate at a time.
edition.cue: Plate up the mains when young Henry starts running errands at the cab stand.

s.note: Paulie's razor blade garlic, sliced so fine it melts in the oil
s.how: Slice 6 garlic cloves paper thin on a mandoline and cook in 80ml extra virgin olive oil over low heat for 5 minutes until soft and barely golden. Grill 8 slices of ciabatta, rub with the cut side of 2 halved tomatoes and season with salt. Spoon the garlic and its oil over the top and finish with torn basil.

s.note: poached prawns on iceberg with brandy Marie Rose and paprika, served in coupes at the Copa
s.how: Poach 500g peeled green prawns for 2 minutes in salted water with a slice of lemon, then chill in iced water. Mix 120g mayonnaise with 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, a few drops of hot sauce and 1 tsp brandy. Shred half an iceberg lettuce into four coupes, add the prawns and spoon over the sauce. Dust with paprika and serve with lemon wedges.

m.note: veal, beef and pork, and fewer onions than Vinnie uses
m.how: Soak 2 slices bread in 80ml milk, then mix with 200g veal mince, 200g beef mince, 200g pork mince, 1 egg, 40g grated pecorino, chopped parsley and 1 crushed garlic clove. Roll into 16 balls and brown. In the same pot gently cook 4 garlic cloves sliced razor thin and half a diced onion, add 800g San Marzano tomatoes and the meatballs and simmer 90 minutes. Serve over 500g spaghetti.

w.note: a hot Brooklyn summer on the corner
w.how: Simmer 200g caster sugar with 500ml water and the zest of 2 lemons for 5 minutes, then cool. Stir in 250ml lemon juice, about 6 lemons. Pour into a shallow tray and freeze, scraping with a fork every 30 minutes for 3 hours until light and fluffy. Serve in paper cups.

d.note: whisky, honey ginger syrup, lemon and soda over big ice, toasting the Lufthansa score
d.how: Make the syrup: simmer 60g honey, 60ml water and 30g sliced ginger for 5 minutes, then cool and strain. Fill 4 highball glasses with large ice cubes. Add 45ml Scotch, 15ml ginger syrup and 10ml lemon juice to each and stir for 10 seconds. Top each with 120ml chilled soda water, stir once and finish with a curl of lemon peel.
